facts.fact: SMART Zambia's e-Government division is stated to have developed the Citizens Support Portal, a Public Service Portal, an e-KYC system, the electronic Constituency Development System and the Contract Tracking System; no date for the development is given, so the document's publication date is used.

The SMART Zambia National Coordinator said 290 services were deployed on the Government Service Bus in the past six months and the e-Government division had digitised 400 health facilities in 20 districts using SmartCare Pro; publication date used as no other date is given.
